name: How long does a typical glass partition installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical glass partition installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a glass partition installation varies depending on the project's scope, the type of partition, and the size of the area. A small, straightforward installation might take a day or two, while larger or more complex projects with multiple offices or custom designs could extend to several days or even a week. Hometelligent Inc. provides a detailed timeline during the initial consultation and site assessment, helping you plan around the installation process efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project scope, partition type, and size, from a few days to over a week for complex jobs.
